newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Babcock drops on restructuring cost news.
newsitem.headline: D.Babcock drops on restructuring cost news.

text.p: Shares in German engineering firm Deutsche Babcock AG lost over ten percent on Monday after the company said restructuring costs would be higher than originally expected.
In a generally firmer market, Babcock was down 5.40 marks to 46.50, after touching a new year low of 46.20.
"We're gradually getting used to hearing worse and worse news from Babcock," said one trader.

Babcock said the closure of its Magdeburg plant and personnel changes in its piping unit and its U.S. operations stemming from a stragegic business plan set in July would all cost more than original estimates.
The DAX index was up 0.35 percent to 2,695.40.
